subject.title: feat(hooks): allow a dedicated queue lane per hook mapping

question: Should OpenClaw support `hooks.mappings[].lane` as a public configuration contract with one independent execution slot per distinct configured lane?
rationale: Source review, tests, CI, and live proof establish that the patch works, but they cannot decide whether this new operator-facing scheduler surface belongs in the product or should be folded into the broader lane/queue design.

options.title: Close pending sponsorship
options.body: Close this PR while retaining the broader issue, and reopen or submit a refreshed implementation if a maintainer sponsors these exact semantics.

options.title: Sponsor and land
options.body: Explicitly accept the mapping-level lane contract and its documented independent-capacity behavior, then proceed through normal exact-head merge gates.

options.title: Fold into broader queues
options.body: Use the canonical per-agent or durable-webhook queue design to define one shared naming and concurrency model before implementation.

recommendation.title: Close pending sponsorship
recommendation.body: Close this PR while retaining the broader issue, and reopen or submit a refreshed implementation if a maintainer sponsors these exact semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The process-global queue and lane-capacity implementation provides the closest available ownership signal for this scheduler product decision.
